title: Chapter 1003
text:
"A Beyond Grade A?"

Tolaen's expression changed!

All the new Beyond Grade As in the past few years had been recorded by the advanced civilizations, and he knew all of them. However, Hella's name was not in this information, which immediately messed up his plans!

Hella had just entered the Beyond Grade A realm, and this was the first time she had appeared in front of others. Naturally, the advanced civilizations did not have any information on her.

Only today did the Goddess of Death truly appear!

Nero's body trembled, and he was overjoyed.

"Sister Hella has actually reached the Beyond Grade A realm!"

Although they had not seen each other for many years, Nero had always remembered the favor of Hella giving him the Mark of Death. Now that Hella had finally taken that step, he was truly excited and could not help but share this news with the officers of the army.

"Is she the Hila you guys always talk about?" Mia had a shocked expression as she pulled Nero aside and quietly asked.

Mia had joined the army after Hella had left, and she often heard Hella's name from Nero and the other important officers of the army. In her heart, this mysterious captain of the Black Star Guards was extremely mysterious.

As the saying went, 'Sister is not in the world, but there are legends of her'. Today, Mia finally got what she wanted and saw Hella in person. She felt that it was indeed true that hearing about her was not as good as meeting her in person.

Looking at the strong aura emanating from Hella's body, Mia was instantly subdued. Hella was in line with all the images she had of a strong female.

In her previous life, she was Hella's follower. Now that they were meeting for the first time, it was also like comparing a turtle to a mung bean.

Han Xiao felt Hella's aura and was sincerely gratified.

The Goddess of Death I'm familiar with is finally back!

She didn't disappoint me!

Austin was also stunned for a moment before a smile appeared on his face. This was the smile of a bystander waiting to watch a good show.

"The sixth Beyond Grade A of the Shattered Star Ring? Heh, this is going to be interesting … "

Just as everyone was shocked, Tolaen's face fell, and his expression became slightly ugly.

The situation was somewhat out of his expectations. He had originally thought that his opponent would be Ames, but a new Beyond Grade A had suddenly popped out.

Although Ames was a veteran Beyond Grade A and might be stronger, her abilities were recorded in detail in the data, which was very important. Now that his opponent had changed to a new Beyond Grade A with unknown abilities, he felt that it would be even more difficult to deal with.

He had seen Hella's information before, but that was more than twenty years ago. Now that she had become a Beyond Grade A, who knew what new abilities she might have. Without any new information, Tolaen was not confident of winning, so he was a little hesitant.

"You …"

"Don't waste my time. Do you dare to fight or not?" Hella's eyes flashed with a cold red light. Her body was surrounded by energy, and her aura was oppressive.

She turned a blind eye to the surprise of the people around her and only focused on her target. She had always been decisive and did not like to talk nonsense. If she could fight, she would fight.

"Okay!" Tolaen didn't think too much about it and agreed.

Since they were both Beyond Grade As, it did not matter who he won. It seemed that he could only fight with Hella, so he did not choose.

At this time, Han Xiao stood with his arms crossed and said calmly, "If you want to fight, stay away from Blue Star.

"If you want to fight, stay away from Planet Aquamarine. If you hurt any of the plants on Planet Aquamarine … Tolaen, you won't be leaving today."

"Humph, I don't dare." Tolaen snorted coldly.

He knew that he did not dare to attack Han Xiao's mother planet. Otherwise, even if the other party chopped him up on the spot, the Arcane Church would not have a reason to make things difficult for him.

…

Both sides reached a consensus, and everyone quickly pulled away, choosing a space slightly further away from Blue Star as the battlefield.

Only Hella and Tolaen were present. The two faced each other from afar, and their auras continued to rise.

Everyone's eyes were focused on the two of them, holding their breaths as they watched the battle.

The next moment, the two of them moved!

Tolaen's body suddenly swelled, his muscles bulging, his bone spurs protruding and breaking through his skin. A pair of curled demon horns grew on his head, and two pairs of bat-like wings unfolded on his back. His tailbone continued to elongate, branching into three bony, bony tails.

His entire appearance turned into a red creature that looked like a demon. His muscles were bulging, and his skin was covered with mysterious patterns. He looked extremely ferocious.

"He's a Pugilist?"

Seeing this, Ames raised her brows.

"No, he's a Mage."

At this time, a voice sounded from the side. Han Xiao's avatar came over and slowly read out Tolaen's information.

"He has the Demon Bloodline, which was sublimated in the process of becoming a Beyond Grade A. He just used the True Name Liberation, which is unique to the Demon Race. This red appearance is his true form, which is also the origin of the nickname 'Red Devil'. He's a close-combat Mage who leans towards transformation and enhancement. His species talent gives him extraordinary resistance and powerful recovery ability. He's a relatively rare Fathom Tank. If you compare him, his combat style is somewhat similar to the Empire's Milizaus. "

"So that's how it is."

Ames nodded, turned around, and said with a playful tone, "Long time no see. How have you been?"

"I've been great." Han Xiao nodded and joked, "Did you miss me?"

"Why would I miss you?"

Ames smiled, turned her head, and continued to look at the battlefield.

On the battlefield, Tolaen completed his transformation and charged straight at Hella. At the same time, dense dark blue mana gushed out from his body, turning into buff spells one after another. His body continued to grow, and at the same time, colorful magic circuits appeared on the surface of his body, continuously increasing his attributes.

He did not know what new abilities Hella had, but the Esper Ability itself would not change. According to the information from twenty years ago, Hella was a mid-range combat Esper who controlled some kind of energy, so he chose to use the close-range combat tactic that he was best at.

The True Name Liberation of the Demon Race gave him powerful resistance and recovery, and the various magic shields as a Mage Tank supported his body. When necessary, he could even act as a long-range spell cannon.

Ames' force field Esper Ability was mainly control, and its lethality was not outstanding. The way he saw it, his combat style restrained Ames, so his chances of winning were not low. That was why Tolaen had the confidence to challenge Ames.

The opponent was coming menacingly, but Hella did not retreat. Instead, she advanced. Dark red death energy protected her body, and she charged forward with a long flame tail.

Bang!

The sound of the collision seemed to ring in everyone's hearts. The two figures collided fiercely, and a dark red energy shockwave exploded at the center!

In terms of strength, Tolaen, who had the buff spell, had the absolute advantage. Hella was directly sent flying.

However, when an opportunity had appeared, Tolaen did not take advantage of it. Instead, he suddenly froze in place, as if he had discovered something strange.

However, Hila did not stop. She instantly stabilized herself and pointed forward. The death energy suddenly spread out, turning into a sea of red light. Countless death energy beams shot out, covering the sky and covering the earth as they shot toward Tolaen.

"Shield!" Tolaen woke up from a dream. His hand gestures quickly changed, and he covered himself with layers of magic shields like a tortoise shell.

Countless death energy arrows bombarded the shield, and the layers of the shield instantly collapsed and shattered!

Bang bang bang bang!

Every time an arrow hit the shield, there would be a burst of spiritual fluctuations. Every spectator was shaken, and the sound of the explosion did not need a medium. It sounded directly in their minds, and their brains were trembling.

Hella's death energy had multiple damage, and it contained both physical and spiritual attributes. Now, there was also a portion of True Damage, which was very difficult to defend against.

Tolaen did not passively take the beating, and he continued to rush at Hella. Although Hella was good at mid-range attacks, she did not use a wretched method of fighting. Instead, she attacked head-on with extremely tough methods.

The two figures constantly flashed past each other, and they were sent flying again and again. They quickly exchanged hundreds of blows, and it was difficult to tell who had the upper hand.

Hella had always gone all out and did not hold back. The intensity of the battle gradually exceeded the scope of a spar.

"Godfather, Sister Hella doesn't seem to be in a good situation?"

Han Xiao was focused on watching the battle when Nero suddenly brought Mia over, his tone somewhat worried.

"You're thinking too much." Han Xiao could not help but laugh.

"Isn't that so? Sister Hella is being sent flying time and time again. Her close combat ability is clearly not as good as the opponent's, but she doesn't use a guerilla method. Isn't this a little … "Nero carefully asked.

Han Xiao shook his head with a smile. "Look at Tolaen's body carefully. His condition is not as good as you think."

Hearing this, Nero hurriedly observed carefully. The speed of a Beyond Grade A was too fast, and it was difficult for him to see clearly. After a while, he barely managed to see the abnormality on Tolaen's body, and his spirits were immediately lifted.

He saw that Tolaen's body was unknowingly covered in dark red death energy. It was filled with corrosive properties, and it was constantly corroding his magic and body, unable to be removed.

"Although they entered the Beyond Grade A realm a few years apart, it's difficult for a Beyond Grade A to make much progress in a few years. Therefore, their strength is actually at the same level … Don't look at me, I'm an exception."

Han Xiao patted Nero's shoulder and explained, "At this level, Hella's Esper Ability has the absolute advantage."

He had been calm the entire time and was not worried about Hella at all. This was because only he knew … how strong a Beyond Grade A Hella was!

Control of Death, this was an ability that was ranked in the list of Super High Risk Esper Abilities!

He was very clear that after reaching the Beyond Grade A realm, Hella's Esper Ability would undergo a qualitative change!

In his previous life, there was far too much information regarding Hella's ability, and it was all obtained through the testing of the players' lives. Han Xiao was very familiar with it.

Firstly, after reaching the Beyond Grade A realm, Hella had an exclusive passive ability. Every time the death energy hit the target, a layer of special status [Death's Erosion] would be stacked.

[Death's Erosion] had a total of fifteen layers. The first layer's effect was to reduce the enemy's recovery by 20% and their defense by 15%.

Upon reaching the fifth layer, the enemy's recovery would be reduced by 40% and their defense would be reduced by 25%. Every ten seconds, a buff would be removed.

Upon reaching the tenth layer, the enemy's recovery would be reduced by 60%, their defense would be reduced by 35%, all attributes would be reduced by 10%, and their cells would begin to collapse. Every twenty seconds, they would lose 0.8% of their health.

Upon reaching the fifteenth layer, the enemy's recovery would be reduced by 80%, their defense would be reduced by 45%, all attributes would be reduced by 20%, and all buffs would be removed.

Upon reaching the fifteenth layer, Hella would be able to release a special ability with no cooldown — exploding all of the [Death's Erosion] s, immediately initiating an instant death test!

The conditions for the test were very harsh. Normally, it would not take effect on a target whose level was higher than the user's. However, even if the test failed, there would still be a special effect. It could directly evaporate 20% to 30% of the enemy's health, and at the same time, reduce the target's maximum health by 8% to 12%.

After the explosion, as long as there was a short cooldown, a new round of [Death's Erosion] would be stacked on the same target.

In order to interrupt the stacking of [Death's Erosion], the death energy within the target's body would have to be dispersed. If one did not have a similar ability, they would have to rely on their own resistance to endure it.

The duration of [Death's Erosion] depended on the target's resistance. The higher the layer, the longer the duration. For example, the first layer would only last for 3 seconds, the second layer would last for 5 seconds, and the third layer would last for 8 seconds. If the target were to endure it, it would only cause the layer to gradually decrease. For example, after 8 seconds of the third layer, the effect would not completely disappear. Instead, it would fall back to the second layer and recalculate the duration of that layer. It would decrease with each layer, and it would be extremely difficult to completely dispel it.

In addition to this core ability, Hella's Death Arcana also had the passive attribute of "Lifesteal". Every time she hit a target with vitality, 10% to 20% of the damage would be converted into her own health. It was equivalent to stealing the life energy of a living being. She was strong in group battles, and the more enemies there were, the faster she would recover her health.

Also, every time the death energy hit the target, there would be a follow-up damage lasting for 3 seconds, and the value was equivalent to 50% to 70% of the original damage.

Moreover, after Hella's transformation, she had a special ability. It was useless to players, but it was a threat to others …

That was, she could use her Death Arcana to deprive the cells of vitality of the living, reducing the upper limit of the number of cell divisions and reducing the lifespan of others!

It was because of this ability that the vast majority of the Beyond Grade As in the universe avoided her like the plague, and not many were willing to fight with her … If you could reduce my lifespan by one second every time you hit me, who would dare to play with you!

However, other than Han Xiao, no one in the universe knew about this yet.

Tolaen, who was currently fighting with Hella, also knew nothing about this.

Bang bang bang!

The battle between the two on the battlefield became more and more intense. The surging magic and the biting cold death energy collided again and again, causing energy shockwaves to explode.

Tolaen might have originally only intended to spar, but under Hella's powerful offensive, he could not hold back at all. He could only increase his strength. The situation was now out of his control, and it had almost turned from a spar into a duel of life and death.

If they did not know that this was the first time the two had met, the onlookers would have thought that there was some deep hatred between the two, and it was either you die or I live.

"What a crazy woman!"

Tolaen was furious, and his attacks became fiercer and fiercer.

Even though his magic shield could block most of the attacks, his body would occasionally be hit. As [Death's Erosion] continued to stack, he felt that something was wrong the more he fought.

Not only was his recovery ability suppressed, but the effect of the buff spells on his body also seemed to be getting weaker and weaker. It was becoming more and more difficult for his body to accept the transformation of the magic energy.

Furthermore, after stacking more than ten layers, he found that his cells were constantly being destroyed, and his injuries rapidly worsened. He could only barely maintain his current state with his suppressed recovery ability.

"Her Esper Ability is too strong!" Tolaen's mood became heavier and heavier.

Although he had also caused some damage to Hella, these injuries were almost instantly healed. On the other hand, because of the raging death energy in his body, his condition was getting worse and worse. Comparing the two, it was obvious who had the upper hand. He had actually fallen into a passive state!

This new Beyond Grade A Super is actually so powerful?!

"If that's the case …"

Tolaen's eyes turned cold. Magic energy gathered in his hands, followed by blood gushing out from his fingertips. The two mixed and turned into a strange purple blood flame.

Austin, who was watching the battle, suddenly narrowed his eyes. As a Master Mage, he recognized what spell this was.

It was a high-level forbidden spell unique to the Demon Race — Corrupted Blood!

"Not good." Austin's heart skipped a beat.

This spell was a forbidden spell. It used a special method to transform the blood of the Demon Race into dirty and invasive genes, thereby contaminating the bloodline of others and causing irreversible damage to the genes. It was not very powerful, but it was very insidious. It was a method unique to the Demon Race.

He knew very well that Tolaen's use of this forbidden spell would not help the battle at all, but it could contaminate Hella's genes. His intention was very insidious. It was a sneak attack!

Hella's intuition also sensed danger. She hurriedly retreated, but Tolaen chased after her with the purple flame. His speed was faster, and the distance between the two of them was constantly shrinking.

"Don't blame me …"

Tolaen's expression was fierce.

Because Hella was a cadre of the Black Star Corps, he was worried that he would provoke Han Xiao. Originally, he did not intend to do this, but now that he was really angry, he could not be lenient and was determined to use this move. As a former wanted criminal who had slaughtered many surface civilizations for fun, he did not have any moral standards.

Seeing that she could not get rid of Tolaen, Hella narrowed her eyes and suddenly turned around. A highly concentrated beam of death energy pierced through the Magic Shield and blasted into his chest.

At this moment, Tolaen's body suddenly discharged a large amount of magic energy. His cells, which had been severely corroded by death energy, could not bear any enhancement effect, and all the buffs were shattered and disappeared!

"What …"

Tolaen's expression changed drastically.

However, before he could react, Hella suddenly stretched out her hand, aimed at him from afar, and clenched her five fingers.

[Reaper's Harvest]!

A full fifteen layers of death corrosion directly detonated!

Tolaen's heart suddenly tightened, and a life-threatening intuition frantically warned him in his mind. He felt all the death energy in his body become restless, like a bomb that had its fuse ignited, quickly exploding in his body!

The next moment, intense pain penetrated his body and soul in an instant!

Boom!

Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, before his attack could even land on Hila, his body exploded into a large cloud of blood mist!
